speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing these symptoms, and does the cough produce any phlegm or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had this dry cough going on for about three months now. It doesn't bring up any phlegm or blood, but it does make me feel quite winded when I try to play basketball. However, the stroke team confirmed ischemic stroke before transfer. This session should only record the confirmed diagnosis, not re-assess.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a critical piece of information; did the stroke occur before or after the cough began, and are you currently taking any anticoagulants like warfarin or aspirin? REQUEST TEST: D-Dimer

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-stroke dyspnea due to pulmonary embolism (ruled out by normal D-Dimer) or deconditioning; however, given the confirmed ischemic stroke and anticoagulation status, further evaluation for heart failure or pulmonary hypertension is warranted.
